title: Sister thought this was a wonderful gift
text: Sister thought this was a wonderful gift. My sister, age 70, wanted this for her birthday. She loves it. A box of Kleenex does not fit in it. you have to take the tissue out of the box and put it in it. But she loves the conversation it brings from people who come to her parties.  So she is happy with it.
